heading.title: Of the Powers of an Executor or Administrator

article.title: Powers of administrator during minority.
article.content: An administrator during minority has all the powers of an ordinary administrator.
article.html:
314Powers of administrator during minority.

Section 314 · Part IX · Chapter VI · page 84 of the Act

An administrator during minority has all the powers of an ordinary administrator.
